messages:
Maya Singh: quick flag on /v1/embeddings API ref — found three small but confusing mismatches: the request examples show `input` as a single string, the OpenAPI request schema lists `input: string` only, but the runtime accepts an array of strings and returns an object with `data: [{embedding: [...]} , ...]`. the docs also show a top-level `embedding` array in the sample response. folks copying examples are getting unexpected shapes.

Carlos D'Souza: thanks Maya. can you paste a minimal repro and point to the file path?

Maya Singh: repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-4b","input":"hello"}'` returns `{ "data": [ { "embedding": [0.01, ...] } ], "model": "rwd-embed-4b" }` but docs/examples/embeddings.md shows `{ "embedding": [ ... ], "model": "rwd-embed-4b" }` (no data array). also openapi/specs/embeddings.yaml currently marks `input` as string not array.

Ellen Park: confirmed on staging. runtime accepts either a single string or list of strings and normalizes internally to `data` array. we recently standardized the response to always return `data[]` to support batching. docs weren't updated.

Carlos D'Souza: plan: update OpenAPI to allow `input: oneOf [string, array[string]]` (explicit examples for both), update all examples to show the batched response shape with `data` array, and add a short migration note explaining old single-object examples -> new batched response. also add SDK mapping note (JS/py): JS clients expose `input` as either string or string[]; Python client currently documents `input: str` only, will update.

Maya Singh: suggested OpenAPI snippet for the request body (yaml):
```yaml
requestBody:
  content:
    application/json:
      schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          model:
            type: string
          input:
            oneOf:
              - type: string
              - type: array
                items:
                  type: string
        required: [model, input]
      examples:
        single:
          value: {"model": "rwd-embed-4b", "input": "hello"}
        batch:
          value: {"model": "rwd-embed-4b", "input": ["hello", "world"]}
```

Ellen Park: and example response to put in docs/examples/embeddings.md:
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-4b",
  "data": [
    { "embedding": [0.0123, -0.0045, ...] },
    { "embedding": [0.0098, -0.0021, ...] }
  ]
}
```

Carlos D'Souza: small SDK note: JS SDK uses `input` can be string|string[]; Python SDK function signature should be `def embeddings(model: str, input: Union[str, List[str]]) -> ...`. add these snippets to PR so SDK docs reviewers can copy.

Maya Singh: I'll open a docs PR to update openapi/specs/embeddings.yaml, docs/examples/embeddings.md, add docs/migrations/embeddings-batched-response-2026-03.md, and add a CHANGELOG line. will include both curl/python/js examples and the OpenAPI oneOf snippet. PR will also add a short note: "Clients that expected a top-level `embedding` field should read `data[0].embedding` for single-input requests."

docs-bot: PR opened by Maya Singh: https://git.redwood/infer/docs/pull/5312 (labels: docs, needs-review) :eyes:

SDK-team-bot: FYI tagging SDKs — please update Python/JS client docs to accept list input and return batched embeddings shape.

Carlos D'Souza: can we also add a small integration test in infra/integration/embeddings_smoke_test asserting `data` exists and length matches input count? helps prevent future drift.

Ellen Park: good call. I'll open a follow-up infra PR for the smoke test after docs merge.

Maya Singh: assigning reviewers @Carlos D'Souza @Ellen Park. aiming to merge after 2 approvals and green CI. thanks! :sparkles:
